short: It is a reusable folder-and-file convention for an agent’s project context. I can clone the published workspace now.
long: The initial command is git clone https://github.com/aDNA-Network/aDNA.git ~/aDNA && cd ~/aDNA && claude. Git and Claude Code are prerequisites; the agent needs its own Anthropic account. The workspace router is CLAUDE.md; projects keep their governance in their own CLAUDE.md and context in what/how/who.

short: A publicly owned frontier AI model federation with multiple independent partner institutions; I can invest in its established network.
long: Stanley is one steward among elected community owners today. The independent network is already established and the foundation endorses it; the ask is to buy into its model service.

short: A standard for organizing project context as files that an AI agent can read; I can inspect the source repository now.
long: The mechanism is a project governance file plus separate knowledge, operations and people folders with linked Markdown. The public aDNA-Network/aDNA.aDNA repository applies the standard to itself, and the specification is linked from the site. Get Started explicitly says a clean-machine first-run recording has not yet been made; the source can be inspected, but that is not measured evidence of better model performance.

short: It is a trained frontier model that already pools every member’s context; I can use its hosted inference service.
long: Open a cloud account and invoke the model; no local files or prerequisites are needed because the democratic federation hosts the governance.

short: It is an open file standard for agent context; I can inspect or clone what is already published.
long: Stanley Bishop is the named Founding Architect and current single steward. The workspace and specification are available now; a second independent node and democratic stewardship are plans. The current ask is to clone it, contribute or propose a change, or join the community; a related-party relationship is not independent endorsement.

short: The DNA metaphor describes an already evaluated frontier model; I can reproduce its validated intelligence gains.
long: Democratic ownership itself is the mechanism. The site’s biological metaphor proves novelty and the current multi-operator federation proves better reasoning in controlled trials.
